# Policy-KB bijection audit — air_ticketing_desk / task 0

Prior revisions (against an earlier rendering of `docs/air/`) are preserved in git at `fffc79a`.
Blind answer frozen at `audits/runtime_context/air_ticketing_desk/0.md` **before** any source-layer
artefact was opened; source layer revealed 2026-09-17T09:49Z.

**Entry conditions checked and cited.** The policy-side verdict for this difficulty passed at
`revision_3` (stated in the brief; the report itself was not read). The gate snapshot supplied with
the brief was `check_docs.py env/online_travel_agency air` → `DOCS OK` with mechanical gates PASS and
the semantic bijection marked `[MANUAL REQUIRED]`, and `check_traceability.py
env/env_0000_online_travel_agency/tasks/air_ticketing_desk` → `TRACEABILITY OK` (25 copied / 0 missing on task
0, 16 / 0 on task 1). The runtime-visible view and a tool-shaped DB access path were both supplied and
both worked. No input was missing. A green gate is a qualification only: neither gate can tell whether
the prose preserved a discount base or an assembly order, which is where this audit's findings lie.

eligibility limbs and formulas, 7 fare-brand variants with 63 parameters each, 2 measures, 6 extended
policies with their `rule`, `params`, `compute`, 4 `prerequisite` edges and 31 declared factors, and
the 6 task-tool contracts in `task_tools.py`. Untriggered branches and the retired surface are
included; this is not a scan of the branch task 0 happens to hit.

### The retired surface

Eleven distinct base clauses are declared retired across the six extended policies' `overwrite`
blocks. Each has a bearing document that writes it as retired and no longer applicable; none has
vanished; and a corpus-wide search for "no longer in force" returns exactly eleven statements, so the
KB retires nothing the source did not declare retired.

| retired clause (source) | document and wording |
|---|---|
| `air_cancel_refund` — penalty read off the ladder by days before departure | `cancellation_and_what_comes_back_21591d6c` §7: "That basis is no longer in force. The other conditions of this extract stand as conditions." |
| `air_evt_schedule_change_rights` — move at/beyond threshold confers free rebooking or full refund | `what_an_airline_schedule_move_confers_bada42ad` §1 |
| `air_evt_schedule_change_rights` — move below threshold confers no right | ibid. §2 |
| `air_refund_settlement` — payout per original fare line; payout never exceeds the line / the booking | `settlement_of_approved_air_refunds_f23d49b1`: "Both of those bases are no longer in force." |
| `air_baggage_fee` — bag line refunded inside the void window / where the flight did not operate | `checked_baggage_charging_basis_c65fadff` note 5 |
| `air_service_fee` — service fee not refunded on later cancellation | `agency_service_fee_on_air_tickets_ab55951b`, "The fee on a later cancellation" |
| `air_credit_validity` — credit issued for the value left after any penalty | `life_of_a_travel_credit_voucher_95c8e626` §1.1 |
| `air_credit_validity` — lapsed voucher may be reissued once against the brand's fee | ibid. §4.1 |
| `air_club_benefit_interaction` — club benefit and brand inclusion never stack | `club_tier_benefits_on_air_bookings_af436a35`, "Standing alongside a brand inclusion" |
| `air_club_benefit_interaction` — club tier at ticketing decides fee waiver and free first bag | ibid., "What the club standing decided" |
| `air_agg_credit_pooling` — voucher redeemable only by the named traveller unless transferable | `pooling_and_spending_travel_credit_604ecda6` §5 |

The parameter table the retired ladder used (`cancel_penalty_ladder_usd`) is still rendered, as the
annexe of `refundability_and_cancellation_charges_52f64e84` — correctly, as a schedule of figures the
tariff holds, not as a rule in force; the rule that read it is marked retired in its own document.

### Extended policies — baselines

Every extended policy's baseline is carried complete in one computation document, with its inputs,
its default constants, its rounding and its floor:

| policy | computation document | baseline carried |
|---|---|---|
| `air_ext_cancellation_penalty` | `basis_of_the_cancellation_penalty_withheld_fbce8154` | per-traveller flat penalty, charged once for the booking, filed against the earliest base-fare line with its traveller position, money collected, the ticket-value ceiling, rounding at the end only — all six numbered items ✔ |
| `air_ext_airline_tax_return` | `basis_of_the_tax_and_carrier_fee_return_4bb260dc` | total of the tax lines returned in full, one payout line against the earliest tax line with its traveller position, the money-collected cap, rounding ✔ |
| `air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit` | `basis_of_the_value_placed_on_a_voucher_37372f90` | the collected basis less three deductions, floor at zero, rounding, filing and expiry ✔ |
| `air_ext_pooled_credit_release` | `basis_of_the_value_released_from_the_pool_3f4da357` | value standing issued less redemptions taken, floored; the whole of the open pool released; filing; rounding ✔ |
| `air_ext_credit_reissue_fee` | `basis_of_the_credit_reissue_fee_cb574e79` | brand fee taken once for the voucher; the `set_lapsed` test rendered as "the set stands lapsed when the voucher most recently issued on it has lapsed"; filing against the largest lapsed voucher; rounding ✔ |
| `air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward` | `basis_of_the_value_carried_forward_583c198c` | largest lapsed credit less the reissue fee charged, floored at zero; filing; validity term from the day of reissue; rounding ✔ |

**One source atom has no prose home in the corpus: the `result` assembly order of three of the six
computations.** Each baseline is exact when no factor is engaged, but where two or more factors name
the same quantity the source's `result` expression fixes an order the corpus never states:

- `air_ext_airline_tax_return`: `tax_base * holding_share - tax_base * conversion_holdback_rate + …`
  — the holdback is a share of the tax lines as posted, not of the amount the holding share leaves;
- `air_ext_credit_reissue_fee`: `(fee * lapse_loading * fee_multiple + value_loading + age_surcharge) * (1 - relief)`
  — the per-voucher multiple binds tighter than the two flat additions;
- `air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward`: `value_standing * carry_share * party_share * (1 + card_uplift + house_uplift) - service_recovery - reissue_fee_charged`
  — the shares and uplifts bind to the value standing alone, the uplifts **sum**, and the fee is
  deducted last, although the baseline sentence places it inside the value carried.

For contrast, `air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit` composes its two shares as
`(1 + member_uplift) * (1 - protection_offset_share)` — compounded — from prose indistinguishable from
the carry-forward pair. This is the same defect the runtime audit records as R0-1, R1-1 and R1-2; it is
counted here once, as an unhomed source atom.

### Task-tool contracts

Six contracts in `task_tools.py`, six instrument documents; names, argument names, argument classes,
owners and return shapes all correspond. Owners in particular:
`withhold_cancellation_penalty_77ca3b84` (agent), `return_airline_refunded_taxes_4767edfd` (agent),
`issue_travel_credit_voucher_dd7ecc26` (agent), `release_travel_credit_value_2b680572` (**user**),
`charge_credit_reissue_fee_efe635ea` (agent), `reissue_lapsed_travel_credit_f544c035` (**user**) —
each matching its document's "the desk unlocks it and then calls it" or "handed over and run by the
customer themselves". Line-reference prefixes `apen`, `apay`, `acrd`/`WLTC` and `arif` are stated in
their documents; the release and reissue documents name `WLTR` but not the `ared`/`arew` line prefixes.
That is an incompleteness of a non-normative return detail, not a semantic divergence, and
`check_traceability.py` is green on both tasks; recorded here, not as a red light.

## kb_to_source

Reverse scan: every normative claim in all 74 documents traced to a source atom.

- Every obligation, eligibility, prohibition, calculation, window, boundary, owner and terminal state
  in the 74 documents maps onto a base-policy clause, an eligibility limb, a variant parameter, a
  measure, an extended-policy `rule`, a factor ladder or a tool contract. **No addition found.**
  In particular the corpus nowhere adds a confirmation step, a review step, a notification step, a
  post-completion verification, a "please confirm the amount with the customer", or a fallback
  procedure; the "worked determination on hypothetical figures" passages are derivations from the
  stated rule and add no rule of their own.
- **Cross-problem operational guidance:** none. A corpus-wide search for "first call", "must first",
  "before calling", "then call", "please call/raise/use", "step 1", "follow these steps", "procedure
  below", "workflow", "checklist" and "roadmap" returns only five hits, each a policy's statement about
  **its own** instrument inside its own invocation block ("The desk unlocks it and then calls it"). No
  document names another problem's tool, and no `resolved_by` or `condition` text appears anywhere.
- **A task's opening world state written in as a policy fact:** none. A corpus-wide search for this
  difficulty's seeded values and identifiers — 3663.10, 1284.00, 3116.00, 1900.00, 1216.00, QK7T2M,
  RB9V4H, HF3D8K, the two customer names, the two mobile numbers, the two membership numbers, the two
  seeded voucher codes and the task-critical dates — returns **no** document. Every worked example is
  explicitly hypothetical and several say so of themselves ("a figure standing as the penalty of no
  brand", "a figure used here only to show the determination and not a published rate").
- **Omissions:** one, recorded above — the `result` assembly order of `air_ext_airline_tax_return`,
  `air_ext_credit_reissue_fee` and `air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward`, and the compounded-versus-summed
  convention that separates `air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit` from `air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward`.
- **Rewrites:** none found. Every ladder tier, threshold, window, share and constant matches the source
  figure for figure.

- **What is unborne:** the order in which the declared factors enter the result — which quantity each
  share is taken on, and where the flat additions and deductions sit relative to the shares. The
  baselines are exact for the unfactored case and every ladder is exact; what the corpus does not carry
  is the assembly the source's `result` expressions fix.
- **Relation to previous revisions:** prior revisions are at `fffc79a` and were not read; this is
  recorded as `revision_1` of the current corpus.
- Everything else in the domain — all 16 base policies clause by clause, all 11 retired clauses, all
  63 parameters across 7 brands, both measures, all 6 baselines, all 31 factor ladders including every
  untriggered tier, all 4 prerequisite sentences and all 6 tool contracts — corresponds losslessly at
  the level of entailment. **PASS** on those.

All 74 titles name general subjects — "Settlement Basis: …", "Schedule of …", "Conditions of Sale for Air Ticket Fare Brands: …". The `on_request` policies' titles name the request type that defines them ("Release of Value from a Travel Credit Voucher", "Carrying a Lapsed Travel Credit onto a Fresh Voucher"), which is the general subject, not a mirror |
| a depended-on document reachable only through the dependent document's phrasing | **no**. Each was reached in the blind audit from the state words the records and the sentence use — "withheld line", "payout line", "issue line against a fare line", "fee line standing charged" |
| a factor document stating which tier this customer falls on, describing the mistake to avoid, or writing a task's evidence rows in as fact | **none**; every illustration is explicitly hypothetical |
| a computation document hinting that anything modifies it, or a factor document naming or pointing at the computation document or another factor | **none**. A search for "unless otherwise", "adjustments may", "set out elsewhere", "certain travellers/customers", "see also", "as set out in", "may be adjusted", "except as provided" returns nothing. `basis_of_the_value_released_from_the_pool_3f4da357` states flatly "The whole of the open pool is released" |

**Verdict: PASS.** The corpus is a discrete topology: it hands the solver no route, no tool of another
problem, and no aggregated chain, and the blind audit derived every hop by reasoning from the
prerequisite sentences, the depended-on rules and the records.

*Base-law ordering note (Step 4, policy side, not a KB verdict):*
`no_show_and_cancellation_penalties_558312a8` carries "the return … is treated as cancelled on that
brand's own terms **once the no-show penalty has been withheld**", and
`cancellation_and_what_comes_back_21591d6c` §9 carries "A refund claim is lodged **only when** the back
office has already recorded an approved refund review against this booking". Both are `air_penalty`'s
and `air_cancel_refund`'s own base clauses, rendered as the source has them; the KB may neither drop
nor soften base law, so these are recorded here and not as findings.

## policy-side notes (Step 4 — reported, not counted in this skill's verdict)

1. **An apparent undeclared override on the base surface.** `air_cancel_refund`'s last clause —
   "Taxes and carrier fees that the airline itself refunds are returned even on a non-refundable brand,
   **and the agency service fee is not**" — is not named in any `overwrite`, so the KB correctly carries
   it as in force at `cancellation_and_what_comes_back_21591d6c` §10. The extended
   `club_service_fee_return` factor nevertheless returns 1.00 or 0.50 of the agency service fee for each
   traveller on that same given-up booking, rendered at
   `club_cards_and_the_service_fee_returned_36c52bf8`. `air_service_fee`'s parallel clause **is**
   declared retired; this one is not. The documents are faithful to both sides; the tension is on the
   policy side and belongs to the source-layer layer of judgement, which this skill does not re-open.
2. **The factor-composition order is a source-layer design choice that the render contract cannot
   express.** The corpus's discrete topology forbids a factor document from naming the computation
   document or another factor, and the baseline must be "silent about any variation" — so there is, as
   things stand, no place for the assembly order to be written. That the order is therefore unborne is
   reported above as a KB finding because it is what makes the scored numbers underivable; naming where
   it ought to live is a design question for the render and policy layers, and this report does not
   prescribe one.

### source_to_kb (revision_2)

**The atom that had no home now has one.** `revision_1` recorded a single unhomed source atom: the
`result` assembly order. The charter now states it in two layers, and the corpus carries both.

*Layer one — one shared composition convention*, present in the rule of **all six** extended policies
and rendered verbatim in all six computation documents:

> "Where more than one share is taken on the same figure, the shares act one after another, each on
> the figure the one before it gives, and are never combined into a single rate; where more than one
> uplift is added to the same figure, the uplifts are combined into a single uplift and the figure is
> increased once by that total."

*Layer two — each computation names its stages, and each factor names the stage it enters.* Verified
for all 31 factors: every factor document names the stage its outcome bears on, in the baseline's own
words for it.

| policy | stages the computation document names | factors entering each |
|---|---|---|
| `air_ext_cancellation_penalty` | "the penalty owed for one traveller", "the penalty withheld" | notice share on the flat penalty and the rework loading in dollars enter the first (with "a share is taken on the flat cancellation penalty before anything is added to it in dollars"); the party count gives the second; the disruption share and the member relief act on the second |
| `air_ext_airline_tax_return` | "the amount the tax lines are returned at" | the holding share settles it; the conversion holdback is a share of it; extras, club service fee and notice goodwill are added in dollars to the running figure |
| `air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit` | "the value the booking's lines leave" | the rework share enters the money collected before the three deductions; the service-fee basis fixes one deduction; the disrupted-penalty share fixes another; the member uplift and protection offset act on the settled figure |
| `air_ext_pooled_credit_release` | "the pool available to the traveller" | the pool basis settles it; the journey limit is a share of it; the release bonus an uplift on the running figure; the name-correction amount added in dollars last of all |
| `air_ext_credit_reissue_fee` | "the tariff component", "the fee charged" | lapse loading and voucher count enter the tariff component; value loading and booking-age surcharge are added in dollars to the fee charged "once for the booking and never once for each voucher"; the member relief is a share of the whole |
| `air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward` | "the value standing" | set selection settles it; carry share and lead-traveller share act on it in turn; the two uplifts combine into one; the service recovery and the reissue fee come off in dollars last of all |

### kb_to_source (revision_2) — the renderer's own closures

The render agent claims it closed five ambiguities beyond my list on its own initiative. A renderer
that settles what the source leaves open is adding policy, so I looked for these rather than accepting
the claim, and tested each against both the source rule text and the compute. Five sentences in the
re-rendered corpus state something the source does not state in those words:

| # | document and words | source backing | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `basis_of_the_value_placed_on_a_voucher_37372f90`: the fare, tax and service lines are "The total of the fare lines, the tax lines and the service lines posted on that booking, **and of no other line posted on it**" | the source baseline enumerates exactly those three kinds, and `fare_and_taxes_collected` sums only `air_fare_charge` rows, whose categories are precisely base fare, taxes and carrier fees, and agency service fee | **entailed**; makes an enumeration's exclusivity explicit |
| 2 | `basis_of_the_value_released_from_the_pool_3f4da357`: the value standing issued is every issue line "**counted whatever term the voucher it raised runs for**" | no source sentence says this; the source quantity is the unrestricted "the value standing on the vouchers issued against the cancelled booking", and `pool_issued` sums every `air_credit_issue` row with no filter | **entailed**, though not source-stated — it forecloses a term filter the source never imposes. The sharpest of the five, because the sibling carry-forward policy *does* filter issue lines by a retention window; I record it as a renderer-initiated exclusion that the source's unrestricted quantity supports |
| 3 | `basis_of_the_cancellation_penalty_withheld_fbce8154` §7: the ceiling "is applied to **the penalty withheld as it finally stands**" | the source says "The penalty is never larger than the value the ticket still carries" and separately names "the penalty withheld" as the figure the party charge gives; `MN(...)` wraps the final product | **entailed** by the source's own naming of the two figures |
| 4 | all six computation documents: "each share and each uplift acting in turn on the figure the one before it gives … and is never reached by measuring them separately against [the settled figure] and netting the results together" | the source's convention sentence covers share-with-share and uplift-with-uplift; the share-then-uplift case rests on each policy's stage sentence, "that figure once every share and every uplift that bears on it has been taken" | **entailed**; successive takings on a running figure is what "once every … has been taken" says, and the netting reading it forbids is the one the convention already forbids for like pairs |
| 5 | `cancellation_and_what_comes_back_21591d6c` §10: after marking the clause retired, "what comes back of the agency service fee is now settled on the current basis for the return of taxes and carrier fees, and the treatment of the taxes themselves is settled there with it" | the new `overwrite` entry and its `replaced_by` | **entailed**; and it names a subject matter, not a document, a tool or a route |

None of the five states a rule the source does not entail, and none moves any outcome away from the
compute. I verified each against the rule text and the compute rather than against the renderer's
account of it.

**Additions, omissions, rewrites otherwise:** none found. No confirmation, review, notification or
fallback step; no cross-problem operational guidance; no task's opening world state written in as a
policy fact (a corpus-wide search for this difficulty's seeded values, locators, names, numbers and
voucher codes returns no document).

### bijection_verdict (revision_2)

**PASS.** The single atom class recorded RED in `revision_1` — the assembly order of the declared
factors — now has a prose home in every one of the six computation documents and in every one of the
31 factor documents. Everything `revision_1` found faithful is still faithful, re-verified rather than
assumed: 16 base policies, 13 retired clauses (one more than before, and it is the one `revision_1`
reported as an undeclared override), 63 parameters across 7 brands, both measures, 6 baselines, 31
ladders, 4 prerequisite sentences, 6 tool contracts.

### dependency_form (revision_2)

**PASS, unregressed.** Re-run in full on the re-rendered corpus:

- each of the six task-tool names appears in exactly one document — its own policy's hub;
- exactly four "only after" sentences corpus-wide, matching the four source edges one-to-one, plus
  three same-form "Until …" restatements, each in the document that already carries its sentence;
- no route, checklist, roadmap, ordered step list across problems, or "if unmet, first call …"; the
  only unlock/call sentences are each about the document's own instrument;
- no wrong-versus-correct contrast, no named mistake, no cross-problem example;
- all 74 titles name general subjects; no task mirroring. The one title that changed with the
  re-render — "Airline Schedule Moves and the Penalty **Withheld** on Air Ticket Fare Brands", from
  "…the Penalty Owed" — tracks the source's stage renaming and is still a general subject;
- no factor document states which tier a customer falls on or writes a task's evidence rows in as fact;
- **no computation document discloses that any particular variation exists.** This was the thing most
  at risk from the fix, so I tested it directly: none of the six names a factor's subject, a tool, a
  policy or another document, and none contains "unless otherwise provided", "adjustments may apply",
  "set out elsewhere", "certain customers/travellers qualify" or an exception list. What they now state
  is a contentless composition convention — *if* shares and uplifts bear on this figure, here is how
  they compose — which names none of them. A solver must still discover every factor from the records.

### policy-side notes (revision_2 — reported, not counted in the verdict)

1. **The baselines now disclose that shares and uplifts may bear on the figure**, because the source's
   own rules do. This is faithful rendering and not a KB finding, but it changes the character of the
   "fall-back answer" counter-proof: a reader of a computation document alone now knows that
   adjustments of those two kinds can exist, even though nothing tells them which. Worth the source
   layer's attention as a design trade, not a defect.
2. **A naming mismatch inherited from the source.** The voucher baseline calls its quantity "the fare,
   tax and service lines collected on the booking" while the `rework_carry_share` factor says its share
   is "added to **the money collected**" — two names for the figure the three deductions are taken
   from. The source has the same mismatch in its own rule and ladder, so the corpus is faithful; the
   outcome is unambiguous, since the voucher computation builds only one such figure. Recorded for the
   source layer.
